hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Multiple wavefronts propagate simultaneously step by step across the matrix.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Maintain a matrix of arrival times and current cell colors.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: When two wavefronts reach an uncolored cell at the same time step, assign the higher color value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each cell is enqueued and finalized at most once across the traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running separate traversals from each source takes quadratic time in cell count.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracks distance and color grids to handle simultaneous collisions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses multi source BFS level propagation with tie breaking.
